content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Securities Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Selection is based on Short-listing and Interview. The Company shortlists candidates based on academic track record, experience, and suitability, at its discretion; only shortlisted candidates are called for interview. The time, date, and place of interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email; candidates must attend at their own cost. Final selection is based on marks secured in the interview. Candidates must produce photo identity (PAN Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photo/photo-embossed Credit Card) at the interview for verification. Selection is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per Company requirements. Travel reimbursement: Outstation SC/ST candidates called for interview are paid 2nd Class to-and-fro train fare (or actual expenses, whichever is less) by the shortest route, on production of travel proof. This concession does not apply to SC/ST candidates already in service with Central/State Government, Corporations, Public Undertakings, Local Government, Institutions, or Panchayats.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Canara Bank Securities Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the "Careers" page on the company website: https://www.canmoney.in/careers Download the prescribed application form and fill it in with correct and complete details. Sign the completed application form. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (see Documents section below). Email the duly filled and signed application, along with an updated resume, to [email protected] , ensuring your personal email ID remains valid and functional throughout the selection process. Ensure your application, along with copies of relevant documents, reaches the company on or before 15 September 2026, 6:00 PM . Important: The company is not responsible for loss of application/documents in transit, or for late/non-receipt of any email communication. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained. Candidates who applied earlier and were not shortlisted/selected for these vacancies in the last 12 months need not apply again.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (Self-Attested Copies with Application)
content_sections.text: Birth Certificate/SSC/SSLC certificate with Date of Birth Mark sheets and certificates from SSC/SSLC/Class X, PUC/10+2/Intermediate, Graduation, and other qualifications Copies of experience certificates Caste Certificate in prescribed format, for SC/ST/OBC candidates (OBC certificate must contain the non-creamy-layer clause and should not be more than 1 year old) Any other relevant supporting documents Important: When called for interview, candidates must submit originals of these documents for verification. Candidates will not be allowed to appear for interview without producing original documents. Prescribed formats for SC/ST/OBC certificates can be downloaded from www.canmoney.in and must be used strictly.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Calling/admission to interview is purely provisional, without verification of age, qualification, or category; the Company reserves the right to reject ineligible candidates' applications at any stage. Shortlisted candidates must submit all documents pertaining to age, qualification, experience, and caste at the time of interview, for verification against originals. Selected candidates will execute a service agreement and Code of Conduct as per the Company's HR policy. The Company may conduct police verification and/or draw CIBIL Reports of successful candidates. Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or misbehaviour during selection may be disqualified and debarred (permanently or for a specified period) from any examination or selection held by the company, in addition to facing criminal prosecution. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated in Mumbai. The Company reserves the right to stall or cancel the selection process, partially or fully, at any stage, at its discretion.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has Canara Bank Securities notified in 2026?
faq.answer: CBSL has notified 10 posts – AVP Operations (1), CS & Compliance Officer (1), and 8 Assistant Manager/Officer/Junior Officer on Contract posts across various departments in Mumbai and Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Canara Bank Securities Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed by 15 September 2026, till 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an online application portal for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must download a physical application form from the company website, fill and sign it, and email it with their resume to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. Does working at CBSL count as employment with Canara Bank?
faq.answer: No. The notification explicitly states that engagement with CBSL is not employment with Canara Bank and carries no claim against Canara Bank.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Canara Bank Securities Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 20 to 30 years, with 5 years relaxation for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and up to 10 additional years for candidates with relevant capital markets/financial services experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written test for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, selection is based on shortlisting followed by a Personal Interview only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the probation period for selected candidates?
faq.answer: 1 year (12 months of active service) from the date of joining, for AVP/Assistant Manager/Officer posts.

faq.question: Q8. Is this recruitment part of a special SC/ST/OBC drive?
faq.answer: Yes, this notification combines the General Recruitment Process 2026-27 with a Special Recruitment Drive to fill backlog vacancies for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.
